title: Sable and the Summer
author: Gideon Fairweather
blurb: Hazel Winterbourne, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
